## `GET /runs`

Lists and filters runs.

| Parameter     | In    | Type                                                    | Required | Description                |
| ------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------- |
| `experiment`  | query | `string` or `null`                                      | No       |                            |
| `target_type` | query | `string` or `null`                                      | No       |                            |
| `status`      | query | [RunStatus](/reference/api/models/#runstatus) or `null` | No       |                            |
| `label`       | query | `string` or `null`                                      | No       | key=value                  |
| `limit`       | query | `integer`                                               | No       | ≥ 1; ≤ 500 Default: `100`. |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [RunResource](/reference/api/models/#runresource)        |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `POST /runs`

Creates and launches a run from a RunSpec.

**Request body:** [RunSpec](/reference/api/models/#runspec) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [RunResource](/reference/api/models/#runresource) |

## `DELETE /runs/{run_id}`

Delete a run, its bundle and the analyses that included it; only ever a user's request . 409 with the blocks while something needs it.

| --------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `run_id`  | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                                |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [DeleteImpactResource](/reference/api/models/#deleteimpactresource) |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror)   |
